content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**Fix made:** the Client-indemnity prong now reads "(i) any claim arising out of or relating to Client Content, and (ii) any violation of any state or federal law, rule or regulation by Client" — the "the Web Site or" hook and the redundant "or other content provided by Client" tail are both removed, so our indemnity is limited to Client Content plus Client's breach of law, as the preferred element requires.

**Unchanged:** the new § 12(c) TrueLink defence/indemnity (third-party IP infringement, breach of applicable law, TrueLink-caused unauthorized access to Client data, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with the notice, control-of-defence and reasonable-cooperation mechanic; existing § 12(b) breach indemnity retained. All ten preferred elements are now mapped to operative language, and no fallback-only cap or remedy machinery was imported.
